rows.label: Flat LUK
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: LUK %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: FINAL_DAMAGE % (multiplicative source)
rows.semantics: the +1% multiplicative step is exactly x1.01 on the typed Final Damage factor (Into Darkness / Smokescreen / the artifact bucket are separate factors)

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Agile Daggers' (Attack Speed), Channel Karma's (Attack%), Dagger Mastery's (Min Damage), Critical Edge's (Crit Rate, Crit Damage) and Physical Training's (Basic Attack Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Dagger Expert's (Skill Damage, Max Damage), Shadower Instinct's and Shadow Shifter's (Final Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Agile Daggers, Channel Karma, Dagger Mastery, Critical Edge, Physical Training, Dagger Expert, Shadower Instinct, Shadow Shifter)

rows.label: Incoming Hit Rate (hits/sec, Shadow Shifter only)
rows.semantics: Shadow Shifter's counterattack only: hits per second taken x 20% x its hit

rows.label: Pig's Ribbon
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

rows.label: Mushmom's Cap
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (Accuracy vs Evasion not modelled)

rows.label: Lunar Dew
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

cdr.note: step function in fixed-duration content (exact cast counts); fixed-duration content only
